moments.title: Houghton Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The acclaimed electronic music festival, Houghton, returns to Norfolk this week, running from August 6th to 9th, featuring a stacked lineup of DJs and live acts.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Houghton Festival is back! Get ready for four days of non-stop electronic music magic in the Norfolk countryside, kicking off Thursday. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Dance Music Focus
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack is sorted: Houghton Festival brings the best in house, techno, and disco to Norfolk from August 6th. Dive into the lineup!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Dropping
moments.blurb: The UK Official Singles Chart will be updated this Friday, August 7th, revealing the nation's biggest tracks and potential new number ones.

angles.name: Chart Anticipation
angles.copy: New music Friday means a new Official Singles Chart! Who's going to top the charts this week? Any predictions for the biggest tracks?

angles.name: Weekend Playlist
angles.copy: What tracks are you hoping to see climb the Official Singles Chart this Friday? Get your weekend playlist ready!

moments.title: Mo Gilligan's 'Big Chicken' on Netflix
moments.blurb: Comedian Mo Gilligan fronts his first investigative documentary, 'Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy', launching on Netflix UK on August 4th.

angles.name: Documentary Buzz
angles.copy: Mo Gilligan takes on the fast-food industry! 'Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy' drops on Netflix tomorrow. Will you be watching?

angles.name: Mo Gilligan Angle
angles.copy: From stand-up to investigative docuseries – Mo Gilligan's 'Big Chicken' lands on Netflix UK this Tuesday. Expect laughs and revelations.

moments.title: Netflix Thriller 'The Last House'
moments.blurb: The new thriller 'The Last House', starring Greta Lee and Wagner Moura, is set to premiere on Netflix UK this Friday, August 7th.

angles.name: New Thriller Alert
angles.copy: Get ready for a new psychological thriller! 'The Last House' with Greta Lee and Wagner Moura hits Netflix UK this Friday. Perfect for a weekend binge.

angles.name: Weekend Watchlist
angles.copy: Adding 'The Last House' to the weekend watchlist! This new thriller arrives on Netflix UK Friday. Who's watching with the lights off?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, James Hetfield
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield turns 63 today, August 3rd, continuing his iconic career as a pioneer of thrash metal.

angles.name: Metallica Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the legendary James Hetfield! The voice and rhythm guitar of Metallica – what's your favourite riff?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica celebrates his 63rd birthday today. A true rock icon.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, John Paul White
moments.blurb: John Paul White, known for his work in The Civil Wars and as a solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: Folk & Americana
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to the incredible John Paul White! From The Civil Wars to his solo folk mastery.

angles.name: Acoustic Vibes
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the soulful John Paul White, turning 54 tomorrow! His distinctive voice always hits different.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Geri Halliwell-Horner
moments.blurb: Pop icon Geri Halliwell-Horner, famously known as Ginger Spice from the Spice Girls, turns 54 on August 6th.

angles.name: Spice Girls Power
angles.copy: Girl Power! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Geri Halliwell-Horner. What's your favourite Ginger Spice moment?

angles.name: 90s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Geri Halliwell-Horner! Still absolutely smashing it at 54. What's your top Spice Girls track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, The Edge
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge (David Howell Evans), celebrates his 65th birthday on August 8th, known for his distinctive sound and effects.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge! His unique sound has defined generations of rock music. What's your favourite U2 track?

angles.name: U2 Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to The Edge! Celebrating 65 years of one of rock's most influential guitarists. What's your favourite U2 album?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Suzanne Vega
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Suzanne Vega, known for hits like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner', celebrates her 67th birthday on August 10th.

angles.name: Folk-Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the iconic Suzanne Vega! Her timeless folk-pop tracks continue to captivate. What's your favourite song?

angles.name: 80s/90s Hits
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Suzanne Vega! Celebrating the artist behind 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner' as she turns 67. Which hit do you love most?
